create_custom_agent: create a new custom agent with a name, description, model override, tool groups, and SOUL.md personality
list_custom_agents: list all custom agents available in the agents directory including their metadata and SOUL.md content
get_custom_agent: retrieve details and SOUL.md content for a specific custom agent by name
update_custom_agent: update an existing custom agent's description, model, tool groups, or SOUL.md content
delete_custom_agent: delete a custom agent and all its files including config, SOUL.md, and memory
update_user_profile: create or overwrite the global USER.md file that is injected into all custom agents
check_agent_name: validate an agent name pattern and check whether it is available for creation
